description: This is a code-behind source file for the SetExam ASP.NET webpage, managing exam setup, question addition, course selection, and navigation within an online examination system.

classes.name: SetExam
classes.description: Partial class for the code-behind of the SetExam ASP.NET page, handling user interactions and database operations for the online exam setup.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the initial page load event; currently commented out code.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Navigates to the AdminPanel page when the home button is clicked.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Navigates to the AdminQueue page when the profile button is clicked.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Navigates to the AdminLeaderboard page when the leaderboard button is clicked.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates the course dropdown based on the selected semester with specific course codes.

methods.name: clearB_Click
methods.description: Clears input fields related to question and exam setup.

methods.name: AddQB_Click
methods.description: Adds a new multiple-choice question to the database, updates question number, and notifies success.

methods.name: setB_Click
methods.description: Creates a new exam record in the database for the selected course and confirms with an alert.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates course list based on selected semester dynamically.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates the question number textbox based on number of questions for the selected course.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to the login page.
